When message is signed with TSIG and maxLength is just enough to include TSIG. When message contains an OPT record (EDNS0) which may affect size. Also test that internal size is set correctly after exception? maybe not.

Also test that calling toWire multiple times updates size each time (idempotence). Also test that passing maxLength as a very large number but message size > MAXLENGTH still returns truncated? But we can test with maxLength = 65535 exactly and with message size >65535 to see exception.

Also test for maxLength = Message.MAXLENGTH - 1 where message size exactly equals MAXLENGTH, expecting exception.

Also test that toWire returns a new array each call (not same reference). Could be.

1. "Exact fit – maxLength equals required wire size"
   Cases: create message with known size (e.g., simple query header+question). Compute required size (e.g., header 12 + question name + type + class). Use that as maxLength; expect success, length equals maxLength.

2. "Message with TSIG – maxLength just enough"
   Cases: create signed message with TSIG record; compute size; set maxLength = size; expect success.

3. "Message with OPT – maxLength insufficient for OPT"
   Cases: add OPT record; set maxLength smaller than total; expect exception.

4. "Multiple calls – size updates correctly"
   Cases: call toWire with 512, then modify message (add record) and call with 1024; verify size reflects new length.

5. "Zero-length message (no header?)" Actually Message always has header; but if we create empty Message (no question, no sections) and maxLength >0, expect length = header size (12). So test that.

6. "Negative maxLength extreme (Integer.MIN_VALUE)" Already negative case; but we can test Integer.MIN_VALUE to ensure exception.

7. "maxLength exactly Integer.MAX_VALUE" should cap to MAXLENGTH.

8. "maxLength less than header size (12)" Expect exception because can't fit header.

Make sure not duplicate existing: they have zero, negative -1, 10, 70000, 512, 65535, 1024. We need new values and scenarios.
